# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We are committed to a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free community for
everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity
or expression, experience level, nationality, personal appearance, race,
religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards

Examples of positive behavior include being considerate, giving and accepting
constructive feedback, and focusing on what is best for the community.
Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, personal attacks, publishing
private information without permission, and other conduct that would be
inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns through
[GitHub's private vulnerability and report channel](https://github.com/webappsgo/cvedex/security/advisories/new)
with the subject `Code of Conduct`. Maintainers will review reports promptly
and privately and may remove, edit, or reject contributions that violate this
policy. They will communicate the decision to the reporter.
